summary.text: Eva Diaz is a Democratic member of the Arizona State Senate from District 22 who took office on January 9, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Diaz was re-elected on November 5, 2024, defeating Republican Steve Robinson, 64.6 percent to 35.4 percent, after defeating Leezah Sun in the Democratic primary.
She was unopposed in the July 21, 2026 Democratic primary, and the Republican primary for the seat was canceled.
For 2025 and 2026 she was assigned to the Senate Education and Transportation Committee, the Senate Federalism Committee, the Government Committee and the Ethics Committee.
